name: AI team · security review, with role skills
summary: The security-review team where every role has a specialist guide, the security reviewer runs Semgrep, and the reviewer checks every sentence of the requirement.
steps: QA writes boundary, property, hostile-input and concurrency tests
Dev codes one module at a time, defensively
System runs tests → fix if failing (max 5 rounds)
Security reviewer scans with Semgrep and audits → back to Dev (max 2 rounds)
Reviewer checks every requirement sentence → back to Dev (max 1 round)
